Industries / Manufacturing & Logistics

Clear information from the shop floor to the dispatch bay.

Physical operations generate a great deal of information, such as orders, batches, movements and exceptions, and much of it is still recorded on paper or in isolated spreadsheets.

Common challenges

What we tend to hear.

  • 1

    Limited visibility

    Difficulty answering simple questions about order status, stock or capacity without phoning someone.

  • 2

    Paper-based tracking

    Job sheets, delivery notes and checklists that are filled in by hand and filed.

  • 3

    Connectivity on site

    Warehouses and plants where wireless coverage and network reliability are an afterthought.
